purpose: The sixteen semantic regions of UI/UX plan §8.3, per account: where each comes from, and — where the source supplies nothing publishable — which approved alternative fills it.

region_treatments.header_navigation: Rendered as the real LandingHeader (logo, in-page navigation, resolved CTAs, mobile menu). The compiled section is build instruction, never body copy.
region_treatments.footer: Rendered as the real SvFixedFooter. The compiled section duplicates its link list and is never rendered as body copy.
region_treatments.testimonials: Approved factual trust evidence on all eight accounts (binding decisions §2.1 and §2.2). No customer quotation is published.
region_treatments.pricing: Role-appropriate plan access. No amount is published anywhere (binding decisions §2.3 and §2.4).
